neutral_pose.notes: Technically valid RGBA candidate, but the character identity does not match the canonical Lian Wu source/turnaround.

combat_stance.notes: Technically valid RGBA candidate, but it repeats the same non-canonical character identity and cannot advance to runtime bench.

identity_continuity.notes: Canonical Lian Wu has a boyish fighter read, high blue-tied topknot, asymmetric white/water-blue/black/gold outfit, broad blue sash and black trousers. Candidate 01 reads as a different feminine character with long loose hair, purple sash and different costume construction.

weapon_continuity.notes: Candidate cannot be approved against a canonical turnaround that is itself art_correction_required; weapon and sheath design also diverge from the current canonical source.

silhouette_25pct.notes: Upstream identity gate failed; creating silhouette evidence from a rejected candidate is forbidden.

transparent_background.notes: Both candidates are 768x768 truecolor RGBA with transparent pixels outside the character silhouette.

pivot_x_0_5_y_0_92.notes: Godot runtime bench was not executed because identity gate failed.

feet_baseline_tolerance_3px.notes: Both alpha bounds end at y=720; measured baseline delta is 0 px.

bounds_variation_max_8_percent.notes: Neutral and crouched combat stance have intentionally different pose bounds; animation-frame variation remains a later gate.

fallback_replacement_ready.notes: Rejected candidates cannot replace the procedural fallback.

blocking_reasons: candidate identity does not match canonical Lian Wu
canonical turnaround weapon continuity remains art_correction_required
silhouette evidence intentionally not produced from rejected art
Godot runtime bench intentionally not executed for rejected art
decision.next_action: Regenerate neutral and combat stance using the canonical Lian Wu source and turnaround as strict identity references, then rerun this gate.
